root_cause.text: The `parse_dacl()` function in the SMB client reads `sid.sub_auth[2]` of an ACE SID matching `sid_unix_NFS_mode` without verifying that the SID contains at least three subauthorities, leading to an out-of-bounds read when `compare_sids()` matches a SID with fewer subauthorities.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `ppace[i]->sid.num_subauth >= 3` before calling `compare_sids()` in `parse_dacl()`, and the commit message explains that `compare_sids()` only compares `min(a, b)` subauthorities, allowing an ACE with `num_subauth = 2` to match and drive a read four bytes past the end of the ACE.
